behavior: Primary bounded completion only; legacy and subagent paths retain existing behavior
At most one automatic timeout retry per turn, even after an intervening success
Retry re-enters normal per-call budget admission, operation-id generation, cancellation and unchanged deadline
Failed calls retain estimated input-token debit and count toward model-call budget
No automatic replay of executed tool batches; committed receipts preserved
Consecutive timeout or unavailable retry returns deterministic host evidence summary with unknown outcome and partial flag, without a third provider summary call
Streaming fragments from timed-out attempts are not treated as completed assistant messages
limitations: Only TimeoutError from the primary work call is retryable. Network errors and legacy/subagent timeout behavior are unchanged.
Streaming observers may already have received text fragments before a timeout; those fragments cannot be retracted, but are not promoted to successful final messages.
The deterministic host summary reports the existing bounded observer scope; tool reads and shell mutations may not appear as confirmed changes.
